content.text: According to the Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service (LFRS), the fire erupted at approximately 09:30 BST in the White Lund Industrial Estate located in Morecambe.
Eight fire engines were called to the scene of the blaze at an industrial estate on Hoo Hill Lane in the Layton area of the town at about 06:00 BST, Lancashire Fire & Rescue Service said.
